title: Access grant (backend-runtime-v1 / lp-ye4.9)
description: Signed, scoped authority for humans and unknown agents operating on vault paths. BFF validates grants at the boundary and stamps BackendRuntimeContext + ledger actor provenance. Never trust browser-supplied ACL, agent path claims, or unsigned identity bags as authority. Grant identity is separate from DocumentRevision and operation_id.
$comment: Bead lp-ye4.9 / epic lp-ye4. Phase 5 of multiplayer versioning and access ledger.

schema_version.description: Access-grant domain schema major. Bump only with breaking shape changes.

grant_id.description: Stable grant id. Prefixed grant_. Stored on ledger actor.grant_id; never a secret.

tenant_id.description: Tenant this grant authorizes. BFF rejects grants whose tenant_id does not match the request tenant.

instance_id.description: Optional backend instance binding. When set, BFF may reject cross-instance use.

session_id.description: Optional Portal/Office session binding. When set, the grant is only valid for that session: BFF fail-closes (wrong_session) if the request omits sessionId or supplies a different value. Unbound grants (no session_id) may be used without a request session.

path_prefixes.description: Vault-root-relative absolute path prefixes this grant authorizes. Empty array denies all paths. BFF uses these prefixes as the effective ACL after validation — never browser/agent pathPrefixes claims.

capabilities.description: Capability names this grant authorizes (Brain RPC methods and/or feature-like names). BFF checks the operation capability is listed before stamping context.

issued_at.description: When the grant was issued (issuer clock).

not_before.description: Optional earliest acceptance time. Defaults to issued_at when omitted.

expires_at.description: Hard expiry. BFF rejects grants with expires_at <= now.

issuer.description: Optional issuer label (control-plane, host, lab fixture).

backend_profile.description: Optional backend profile name to stamp on context (admin, contributor, agent_run, …).

meta.description: Optional non-authoritative tags (request correlation). Never secrets or raw tokens.

isoDateTime.description: RFC3339 / ISO-8601 timestamp. Prefer UTC with Z.

actorKind.description: Who the grant authorizes. human = Portal user. agent = known backend agent subject. system = host-internal. delegated_agent = agent run under a human/parent grant (unknown or short-lived agent identity).

grantSubject.description: Safe subject identity bound by the grant. Mirrors signed-operation actor fields that may be stamped into ledger events. Never secrets or browser ACL claims.

subject_id.description: Stable subject id for this actor kind.

portal_user_id.description: Portal end-user id when kind is human or when a human delegated the run.

agent_id.description: Agent product/instance subject when kind is agent or delegated_agent.

run_id.description: Agent run / tool-call correlation id when kind is delegated_agent or agent.

grantCapability.description: Capability or method name. Common values: vault.read, vault.write, vault.list, vault.stat, history.list, heads.artifact, heads.workspace. Wildcard forms (vault.*) are issuer convention — BFF may match exactly or by documented prefix rules.

signatureAlgorithm.description: Grant signing algorithm. Production issuers use ed25519. none is offline/fake only — BFF must require allowUnsigned in trust config.

grantSignature.description: Issuer signature over the canonical unsigned grant envelope. key_id identifies the signing key for rotation and trust lookup. BFF never accepts browser-forged signatures as authority.

key_id.description: Signing key identifier. Must be in BFF trusted key set.

value.description: Signature bytes as unpadded base64 (or the literal 'unsigned' when alg is none).

signed_fields.description: Optional explicit field list included in the signature payload.
